transcript:
sara_support: Hey team — customer (AcmeHealth) escalated: embeddings endpoint returning inconsistent vector dims across environments (hosted=768, dedicated=512, private=768). They hit client-side assert failures when traffic shifts between routes. Repro steps and logs below. :frowning:

carla_ml: can you paste the exact request they send and model param? sounds like model variant mismatch (quantized vs full) or alias routing.

sara_support: curl they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-hosted.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-super-1","input":["q1","q2","q3"],"max_batch_size":8}'
```
They call same curl against dedicated (internal host) and private (VPC) endpoints. Hosted returns 768, dedicated returns 512.

dmitry_ml: any chance the dedicated cluster is running a different model revision (embed-super-1@v2) with a different head? Also batching could merge requests and a mis-annotation could drop dims.

ben_infra: I checked routing logs. At 2026-03-01T12:02:14Z the router routed 35% of traffic to dedicated and used model alias "embed-super-1-fallback" when capacity low. alias -> actual model mapping shows embed-super-1 -> embed-super-1-quant512 in dedicated policy.

emily_research: :eyes: That alias fallback explains vector size. But why only sometimes? Could be autoscaler/capacity fallback flip during spike and client isn't handling changes.

sara_support: Customer also reports intermittent 400s when sending batched requests (error: "vector length mismatch in batch response"). Example server log attached:
```
ERROR 12:02:15 batcher.go:87 - batch result mismatch: reqs=6 results_dims=[768,768,512,768,512,768]
```

carla_ml: aha — looks like the batcher combined requests routed to different model variants. Batcher must guarantee model homogeneity per batch. Which batcher config on dedicated? show me service config.

ben_infra: dedicated pool config: "continuous_batching": true, "max_batch_size": 16, "routing_policy": "cost_fallback". There was a recent config change on 2026-03-01 to enable cross-variant fallbacks.

dmitry_ml: cross-variant fallbacks sound dangerous for embeddings. Workaround: force model pinning on client side or have the router include model_version header so batcher partitions by model_version before merging.

sara_support: Customer's immediate ask: 1) how to stop dim flips now 2) why billing spiked (they retried after 400s) 3) repro steps we can run.

carla_ml: Short-term: tell them to set "model_version": "embed-super-1@v1" in payload OR set max_batch_size=1 to avoid cross-request merges. Mid-term: we'll update batcher to partition by model_version; filing ticket.

raj_sales: customer angry about billing — they got charged for retries across endpoints. Can we offer credit while we fix? Also want ETA.

ben_infra: deploy-bot: recent rollout note -> dedicated/batcher service v2.3.1 rolled at 2026-03-01T11:58:00Z with config enabling fallback. Rolling back to v2.3.0 would stop cross-variant merges. I can coordinate rollback if ops approves.

deploy-bot: [deploy] dedicated/batcher v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0 rollback queued by ben_infra. CI checks green.

carla_ml: I'll open an internal bug: MLINF-4721 "batcher merging across model_variants causing embedding dim mismatch". Assigning to eng-runtime. Proposed fix: partition batches by model_id+quantization_tag and fail fast if mixed.

dmitry_ml: repro steps for eng-runtime:
1) start two model variants on dedicated: embed-super-1@v1 (768) and embed-super-1-quant512 (512)
2) enable continuous_batching max_batch_size=8
3) send mixed requests concurrently (some with model_version v1, some without)
4) observe batcher.go error log and client 400s

sara_support: adding customer's minimal reproduction curl loop they ran (they didn't set model_version):
```
for i in 1..100; do
  curl -s -X POST https://dedicated.internal/v1/embeddings \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"embed-super-1","input":["test"]}' &
done; wait
```

emily_research: Also note: private deployment uses a pinned image and didn't pick quantized fallback, which explains private=768. Hosted was pinned to full. Dedicated was the only one with fallback -> dims=512.

ben_infra: next actions I can do now:
- rollback dedicated/batcher to v2.3.0 (stops fallback)
- add temporary router rule to pin AcmeHealth traffic to hosted for 24h
- disable cross-variant fallback flag
I'll start rollback once approval from eng-runtime and support.

carla_ml: for the code fix we want: ensure batcher groups by model_signature and, if mixed, split into sub-batches. Also add an assert and metric (batch_mixed_variants_count) so we catch regressions.

sara_support: I'll tell customer immediate mitigations: use model_version pin OR set max_batch_size=1 OR we can pin their traffic to hosted for 24h. Also offering one-time billing credit for retry storms. Tagging them and asking consent for traffic pin.

raj_sales: please cc me on the credit offer and log the amount suggestion: propose credit = observed_retry_count * avg_token_cost * 1.2 margin.

ben_infra: rolback started. ETA 12m.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollback started dedicated/batcher -> v2.3.0 by ben_infra at 2034567910

carla_ml: created bug MLINF-4721 and linked to infra PR. Assigning eng-runtime lead @carla_ml.

sara_support: thanks all. I'll update the customer now with mitigations and credit offer. Will follow up after rollback completes. :thumbsup:

emily_research: follow-up checklist for postmortem: root cause (routing fallback + batcher merge), short-term mitigation (rollback/pin), long-term fix (batcher partitioning + metrics), customer remediation (credit + docs on model_version pinning).

sara_support: last note — customer sent one failing response body:
```
{"error":"vector length mismatch: expected 768 got 512 for request_id=abc123"}
```

ben_infra: rollback success at 2034567920. dedicated/batcher v2.3.0 active.

sara_support: great, closing loop with customer now. I'll paste their ack back here when they confirm. Thanks everyone.
